summary.text: Frank Lambert is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a repeat candidate who ran for the Michigan House in 2010, 2012, 2014 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Frank Lambert sought the Republican nomination for Michigan House District 69 in 2010 and 2012, losing both primaries to Susan McGillicuddy.
In 2014 he defeated George Nastas III in the Republican primary and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Sam Singh, 67.8% to 32.2%.
Lambert won the Republican primary for District 75 unopposed in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Penelope Tsernoglou, 59.1% to 40.9%.
